title: Rider Terms: How a Cleaning and Damage Fees Charge Is Made
content:
These clauses of the rider terms govern the charging of a Cleaning and Damage Fees assessment at every fee level.

## Clauses in force

1. **Charged on approval, once.** A fee is charged only on an assessment approved at review, once, on approval; it is charged to the rider's card on file when the assessment is approved, and the assessment then shows as charged.
2. **Receipt minimum.** At a receipt-based level, a receipt below the level's smallest receipt amount is denied (below receipt minimum).
3. **Repair above the cap.** The part of a repair above the cap is never charged to the rider, and the driver is referred to the insurance claim desk through a policy-not-covered handoff.
4. **Who pays.** The fee is charged in full to the rider who requested the trip, including for companions, and is never split.
5. **Wayfare Shared trips.** Support may not approve a fee on a Wayfare Shared trip; those reports go to Trust and Safety. Whether a trip was a Wayfare Shared trip is read from the ride option on the trip record.
6. **Fees that fail to collect.** A fee that fails to collect stays on the assessment.
7. **Rounding.** Every computed fee is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end of its computation.

## Retired clauses

Two clauses stating how the amount is set are **no longer in force** and have been superseded by the current basis:

- "At a flat level the fee is the level's flat fee" — no longer in force.
- "At a receipt-based level it is the receipt or estimate amount on file (an estimate settling the fee where the level allows it), capped at the level's receipt fee cap" — no longer in force.

The rest of the clause on receipt-based levels — that a receipt below the level's smallest receipt amount is denied, and that the part of a repair above the cap is never charged to the rider — remains in force as clauses 2 and 3 above.

## Who is charged, illustrated (hypothetical)

| Trip situation | Fee charged to |
|---|---|
| The requesting rider travelled alone | the requesting rider |
| A companion on the request caused the mess | the requesting rider, in full |
| The fare was split with two other riders | the requesting rider, in full; nothing is split |
| The trip was a Wayfare Shared trip | support may not approve the fee; the report goes to Trust and Safety |

superseded_clauses: At a flat level the fee is the level's flat_fee
at a receipt-based level it is the receipt or estimate amount on file (estimate_settles_fee), capped at receipt_fee_cap
